title: The Lair Mouth
text: The quarry's lair is a cave mouth in the hillside, and it is littered with the bones of hunters who came before, still in their rotting leathers, purses still at their belts. The air coming out of it is warm and smells of meat.

options.label: Smoke it out of the lair, and meet it in the open where you can see it.

outcomes.text: It comes out angry and blind with smoke, and you are ready.

options.label: The Leader goes in after it, into the dark where the bones lie.

outcomes.text: Into its own den, in the dark, where it knows every stone. Brave, and foolish, and remembered.

options.label: The quickest loots the dead hunters first. They will not mind.

outcomes.text: A good bow from a dead hand, and behind you, the quarry wakes.
